title: Code-Switching Symphony
script: Watch this! [Formal English] Hello, this is Lola speaking, how may I assist you? [Switch to Pidgin] Ah ah, my guy, wetin dey happen na? [Switch to Yoruba] Ẹ káàbọ̀ ma, báwo ni? [Switch to French] Oui, bonjour, ça va? This na African superpower – 4 languages, one brain, one conversation. Code-switching no be confusion – na cultural intelligence!
caption:
How many languages you fit speak in ONE DAY? 🧠🌍

New Africa kids be like: English at work, Pidgin with friends, Yoruba with family, French for the Francophone deals!

Drop your count below! 👇🏾

Code-switching = SUPERPOWER, not confusion! 💪🏾
